test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On how many pillars do the Union Budget of 2021-22 proposals rest?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• The Budget proposals for 2021-2022 rest on 6 pillars-

 
 
• Health and Wellbeing
 
• Physical & Financial Capital, and Infrastructure
 
• Inclusive Development for Aspirational India
 
• Reinvigorating Human Capital
 
• Innovation and R&D
 
• Minimum Government and Maximum Governance
 
 
 
• Healthcare expenditure has more than doubled for the next fiscal.
 
• The allocation has been increased from ₹ 94452 Cr to ₹ 2.23 lakh Cr (137% increase).
 
• The Union Government allocated ₹ 1.97 lakh Cr for five years from FY22 for Production Linked Incentives.
 
• So far about 1.8 lakh property owners from 1241 villages have been issued property cards. Farm loan allocation has been increased to ₹ 16.5 tn from ₹ 15 tn in the last fiscal.
 
• 100 new Sainik Schools will be opened in partnership with NGOs/private schools/states. Govt has set up a target of setting up 750 Ekalavya model residential schools.
 
• National Research Foundation with an outlay of ₹ 50000 Cr over 5 years has been proposed. ₹ 1500 Cr was allocated for a scheme to promote digital transactions.
 
• To promote ease of doing business, the govt has proposed to set up a Conciliation Mechanism and mandate its usage for quick resolution of contractual disputes.
